scope: Conditional costed reachable-buyer expansion, separate from controller effect; no observed demand or real spending.
trigger: After fixed128-world comparison completes with at least one ordinary positive-profit event policy and funded obligations; otherwise follow diagnosed failure rather than launch expansion.
policy_selection: Use ordinary mean collected revenue among event simple/joint policies with positive mean complete-cost profit and all obligations funded. If both collected revenue and profit weakly favor simple, retain simple. If objectives conflict report both, select higher collected-revenue feasible policy for this bounded followup. No algorithm edits.
resource_boundary: Same original75minute/7200CPU/512MiB allocation, no refresh. Skip if primary completion or publication budget endangered.
demand_assumption: Additional distinct qualified hypothetical buyers reachable through a costed new segment/channel, with unchanged buyer-choice/retention distributions, rivals, service quality and payment obligations. This changes a market assumption and channel arrangement; never attribute it to controller intelligence. Exact new customer IDs and fulfilled work; no growth multiplier.
accounting: Independent equal-capital counterfactuals. Do not add their receipts to primary worlds or to the preserved parent account. Same frozen controller/tools/native audit, actual service work per order.
decision: Choose smallest tested reachable-buyer change improving collected revenue and complete-cost profit on both fresh seeds without unfunded obligations; report failures and stock/capacity constraints. No continuous/global minimum claim.
